_avail.description: Devio UCX Beamtracking™ ceiling microphone, two-channel amplifier, black surface mount
_avail.portsMissing: Install manual used as the data sheet. Amp Out connector is not named directly; RJ-45 follows from the CCA adapter (Cat-5 to euroblock), as on the level-A TCM-XA. Card says PoE 802.3af class 3 / 15.4 W, the manual says 802.3at class 4, 30 W - card poeDrawW/voltage should be checked.
_avail.notes: PoE from the manufacturer's document (takes precedence over the catalog card): "An IEEE 802.3at Class 4 device requiring 30W of PoE+ power" — https://products.biamp.com/api/media/file/biamp_manual_parle-dcm-x-xa-xex_install_jul26_14054.pdf; the card had PoE 802.3af class 3, poeDrawW 15.4

ports.label: Amp Out 1
ports.notes: Amplifier output over category cable (CCA adapter for euroblock speakers); 2 x 4 W RMS or 1 x 8 W RMS, 4/8 ohm

ports.label: Amp Out 2
ports.notes: Amplifier output over category cable (CCA adapter for euroblock speakers); 2 x 4 W RMS or 1 x 8 W RMS, 4/8 ohm

ports.label: Control (PoE+)
ports.notes: To a Devio UCX PoE+ port: network audio and control; PoE+ 802.3at class 4, 30 W

ports.label: Mic In 2 (DCM-XEX)
ports.notes: Optional DCM-XEX expansion mic, up to 10 m; Mic In 1 takes the included microphone
